desc:
Welcome to the night shift at the Animal Hotel!
Team up with friends to verify reservations, inspect IDs, assign rooms, answer room service calls, and handle cleaning, repairs, and supplies.
But watch every guest carefully—some animals are not what they seem. Check their IDs and the security cameras, trigger a lockdown when necessary, and make your decision before the wrong guest checks in.
Keep your sanity, earn tips, unlock new hotel jobs, and see how many nights your team can survive.
